Run pixel-level enrichment pipeline in parallel

Source: R/utils_processing_pixelenrichment.R
preprocessing_run_pixel_enrichment.Rd

Iterates over samples and computes per-spot ORA results in parallel. Returns a named list of per-sample ORA result data frames.

Usage

preprocessing_run_pixel_enrichment(
  intensity.matrix,
  bulk.intensity.matrix,
  metadata,
  anno,
  control.samples,
  comparison.samples,
  min.neighbours = 3,
  pvalue.cutoff = 0.05,
  lfc.cutoff = 0.5,
  test = "t-test",
  background = NULL,
  min_path_size = 3,
  ora_pvalue_cutoff = 1.01,
  min_pathway_hits = 2,
  ncores = 1,
  pathway_table
)

Arguments

intensity.matrix

Spot-by-feature intensity matrix (all samples concatenated).

bulk.intensity.matrix

Feature-by-sample matrix used to build control sets.

metadata

Data frame of per-spot metadata containing Sample and spot_id columns.

anno

Data frame; annotation data for features used by bulk_utils_DA.

control.samples

Character vector of sample IDs to use as controls.

comparison.samples

Character vector of sample IDs to use as comparison samples.

min.neighbours

Integer; minimum neighbours (unused but retained for compatibility).

pvalue.cutoff

Numeric; DE adjusted p-value cutoff.

lfc.cutoff

Numeric; log fold-change cutoff.

test

Character; statistical test to use for bulk_utils_DA.

background

Optional background gene list for ORA.

min_path_size

Integer; minimum ORA pathway size.

ora_pvalue_cutoff

Numeric; ORA p-value cutoff.

min_pathway_hits

Integer; minimum pathway hits required.

ncores

Integer; number of cores for parallel execution.

pathway_table

Data frame of pathway definitions with columns PathwayID, PathwayName, and MetaboliteIDs.

Value

Named list where each element is a data frame of ORA results for a sample.
